=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- prompts/mode-persist-journal-rules.txt:1-2 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new mode prompt starts with `# tier: DEFAULT` and then `=== ATTEMPT JOURNAL REPAIR RULES ===`, and has no `Role: ... Goal: ...` paragraph, so `_extract_identity_recall_metadata_or_raise` in scripts/render_prompt.py (lines 510-538) raises `IdentityRecallParseError("metadata_extract_failed")`.
  WHY: tests/test_identity_recall_render.sh:27 adds every `prompts/mode-*.txt` file to MODE_PROMPTS, so `test_flag_on_renders_identity_block_for_mode_prompt_corpus` (lines 147-156) fails on head 14ea0f10 with `IDENTITY_REINJECT_PARSE_FAIL: mode-persist-journal-rules reason=metadata_extract_failed`. Any render with `UNATTENDED_IDENTITY_REINJECT_ENABLED=true` fails the same way. All four reviewers rated this BLOCKER.
- prompts/_templates/mode-persist-journal-rules.txt:1-2 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: This byte-identical template copy also has no `Role: ... Goal: ...` metadata header.
  WHY: It has the same root cause and the same metadata_extract_failed parse failure as the main prompt, and it needs the same one-line fix. All three reviewers rated it BLOCKER.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:implement_prepush_test_gate_journal_blocks (`cat "${rules}"`) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The rules fragment is pasted into the repair prompt raw, without going through render_prompt.sh. Its `# tier: DEFAULT` line, and the Role/Goal line once that is added, end up in the middle of the repair prompt.
  WHY: This only happens when PERSIST_JOURNAL_ENABLED=true. The model gets prompt-metadata noise but nothing crashes. Both reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:review_prepush_test_gate_journal_blocks (`cat "${rules}"`) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: This is the same raw `cat "${rules}"` as in the implement gate, so the metadata lines leak into the review repair prompt.
  WHY: Only switch-on runs are affected, and there is no crash. Both reviewers rated it NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "The P1 deliverables and tests listed in the plan are implemented and pass." (linked issue #8428, Acceptance criteria)
  expected_change_site: The first lines of prompts/mode-persist-journal-rules.txt and prompts/_templates/mode-persist-journal-rules.txt: add a `Role: ... Goal: ...` line after `# tier: DEFAULT`. The line must match the regex at scripts/render_prompt.py:43.
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No hunk adds a Role:/Goal: line to either copy. tests-hooks-and-orchestrator fails on head 14ea0f10 in test_flag_on_renders_identity_block_for_mode_prompt_corpus (tests/test_identity_recall_render.sh:147-156) with IDENTITY_REINJECT_PARSE_FAIL reason=metadata_extract_failed. The last run added only `# tier: DEFAULT`, which satisfies tests/test_prompt_size_budget.py but not the identity-recall check. glm offers a second fix: move the fragment out of the `mode-*.txt` corpus and update the gate scripts' locate paths and the implement.yml staging pair to match.
- requirement: "Stay inside the files the plan lists for P1. Do not reflow unrelated code. Prefer append-only edits in shared files." (linked issue #8428, Scope)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/ci.yml (line 657, the added tests/test_attempt_journal.py pytest line) and docs/INVENTORY.md (additions at lines 25-31 and 122-128)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The last run, commit 14ea0f10, edited .github/workflows/ci.yml and docs/INVENTORY.md, and neither is in the files_touched grant. The autofix summary itself says so. tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py is listed among the pre-push gate failures. The reviewers disagree on the fix. sonnet says both edits are required by repository guards (CI wiring and inventory parity), so they should stay and the scope extension should be recorded. minimax says revert them or route them through in-scope files. glm deliberately did not re-flag this gap: it says tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py and inventory parity force these edits.
- requirement: "With the switch off, every prompt is byte-identical to before." / "Switch-off byte identity. For every phase, render the affected prompt, PR body, issue body or plan comment with the switch off and compare it to fixtures captured from main at c4c4f74." (linked issue #8428; docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md:239)
  expected_change_site: tests/test_workflow_untrusted_input_contract.py (or new tests under tests/): rendered-prompt byte-identity tests for scripts/run_plan_codex.sh (lines 299-318), the implement.yml prompt assembly (lines 3185-3194), and scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh (lines 1308-1323 and 1454-1463)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: test_attempt_journal_readers_append_after_dynamic_context_and_are_gated (tests/test_workflow_untrusted_input_contract.py:534-604) checks only source ordering, the switch gating and the support-dir path. Rendered byte-identity tests exist only for the two gate repair prompts (tests/test_implement_prepush_test_gate.py::test_journal_off_repair_prompt_is_byte_identical and tests/test_review_prepush_test_gate.py::test_journal_off_prompt_is_byte_identical). Nothing renders the plan, implement or review-editor reader prompts and compares them to a baseline. Severity disagreement: gemini and minimax rated this MAJOR, luna and glm rated it NIT.
- requirement: The P1 entry schema defines `failure_key` as the first 12 hex characters of `workflow_failure_heal.fingerprint(...)` for a failure.
  expected_change_site: scripts/attempt_journal.py and the stage writer call sites
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: attempt_journal.py computes the fingerprint only when it gets --failure-workflow and --failure-text-file, and no stage writer passes them, so failed attempts store `failure_key` as "". sonnet and glm explicitly rejected this as a gap, because docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md:320 allows "" in P1.
- requirement: ShellCheck on orchestrate_poll_process.sh ran out of memory, and the failures remain in the PR gate.
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The new shell blocks in orchestrate_poll_process.sh have not been lint-checked, and the CI failures remain.
- requirement: "The P1 deliverables and tests listed in the plan are implemented and pass." The pre-push gate lists `ruff` and `shellcheck` as failures caused by this change.
  expected_change_site: scripts/attempt_journal.py (ruff); the persist_journal_stall_context block in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh lines 19472-19526 and the nested `${HEAD_REF:-${PR_HEAD_REF:-${TARGET_BRANCH:-${GITHUB_HEAD_REF:-}}}}` chain in scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1317, scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:705 and scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:299 (shellcheck)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: No hunk in last_run_diff targets a ruff rule or a specific shellcheck diagnostic. The gate summary still lists ruff and shellcheck as failures. shellcheck on orchestrate_poll_process.sh ran out of memory locally, so it was never verified.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- prompts/mode-persist-journal-rules.txt (and its byte-identical copy prompts/_templates/mode-persist-journal-rules.txt):Lines 1-2 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The file has no "Role: ... Goal: ..." paragraph. _extract_identity_recall_metadata_or_raise in scripts/render_prompt.py (lines 510-538) skips the "#" line, and the first paragraph does not match ROLE_GOAL_LINE_RE, so line 538 raises IdentityRecallParseError("metadata_extract_failed").
  WHY: CI job tests-hooks-and-orchestrator fails on head 14ea0f10 in test_flag_on_renders_identity_block_for_mode_prompt_corpus (tests/test_identity_recall_render.sh line 154). Minimal fix: add a Role/Goal line after "# tier: DEFAULT" in both copies.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh and scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:implement_prepush_test_gate_journal_blocks and review_prepush_test_gate_journal_blocks, at `echo; cat "${rules}"` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The rules fragment is copied raw, without render_prompt.sh, so "# tier: DEFAULT" (and the Role/Goal line, once added) lands in the middle of the repair prompt.
  WHY: Only when PERSIST_JOURNAL_ENABLED=true. There is no crash, and the tests only check substrings. Hardening suggestion: replace `cat "${rules}"` with `grep -v -e '^# tier:' -e '^Role: ' "${rules}" || true` (2 lines; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1).
- TASK_GAP | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  Requirement: "The P1 deliverables and tests listed in the plan are implemented and pass." (linked issue #8428, Acceptance criteria)
  Expected change site: The first lines of prompts/mode-persist-journal-rules.txt and prompts/_templates/mode-persist-journal-rules.txt.
  Evidence of absence: No hunk adds a Role:/Goal: line. tests-hooks-and-orchestrator fails with IDENTITY_REINJECT_PARSE_FAIL.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  Requirement: "Stay inside the files the plan lists for P1." files_touched lists six workflows plus tests/**, changelog.d/* and agents.d/*.
  Expected change site: The scope declaration for .github/workflows/ci.yml and docs/INVENTORY.md, or the edits to them reverted.
  Evidence of absence: The last run edited ci.yml (added tests/test_attempt_journal.py to the pre-push gate tests step) and docs/INVENTORY.md (two entries). Neither path is granted. tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py is among the gate failures. Both edits are needed by repository guards, so keep them and record the scope extension.
- Skipped: the failure_key / --failure-workflow / --failure-text-file request, because the plan allows failure_key "" in P1.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
